description: Astronomers are testing a new way to measure the universe’s expansion rate using the gravitational-wave background detected by NANOGrav. By treating the cosmic hum from merging supermassive black holes as a statistical “stochastic siren,” researchers hope to calculate the Hubble constant and help resolve the long-standing Hubble tension between supernova and cosmic microwave background measurements.
title: Hubble Constant Puzzle Deepens as Supernova and CMB Measurements Clash

description: Apple introduced the MacBook Neo on Wednesday as its new affordable laptop. It features a 13‑inch Liquid Retina display and is powered by the A18 Pro chip, previously seen in the iPhone 16 Pro models. Available in four colours, it includes a Magic Keyboard, multitouch trackpad, Touch ID, and offers up to 16 hours of battery life.
title: MacBook Neo Launched in India With 13-Inch Liquid Retina Display, Apple's A18 Pro Chip: Price, Specifications

description: Samsung may soon launch the Galaxy A37 and Galaxy A57, with recent leaks revealing details about their specifications and design. New Geekbench listings suggest both smartphones could offer improved performance over their predecessors. The Galaxy A37 (SM-A376B) scored 1138 in single-core and 3450 in multi-core tests, while the Galaxy A57 (SM-A576B) recorded 1385 and 4469. The phones are expected to feature Exynos chipsets, Android 16-based One UI 8.5, triple rear cameras, IP68 ratings, and a 5000mAh battery with 45W fast charging.
title: Samsung Galaxy A37, Galaxy A57 Spotted on Geekbench With Better Results Ahead of Anticipated Launch

description: Vivo has launched the X300 FE in Russia, a rebadged version of a Vivo S series phone that was launched in China. It features a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 processor and runs Android 16 with OriginOS 6. The phone includes IP68 and IP69 dust‑ and water‑resistance, a triple‑camera setup, and a 6,500mAh battery supporting 90W FlashCharge fast charging.
title: Vivo X300 FE Launched With Snapdragon 8 Gen 5, 50-Megapixel Telephoto Camera: Price, Features

description: It’s too early to say if Marathon’s complete package is worth the $40 asking price. But it’s also not a great sign when a sizable section of a live service game’s early experience doesn’t feel inviting. Despite solid shooting fundamentals and a distinct art style, Marathon will need to do more stand out in a competitive space.
title: Marathon Server Slam Impressions: Can Bungie's Live Service Shooter Go the Distance?

description: Vivo V70 FE will launch in Indonesia on March 9. The handset is set to feature a dual rear camera setup led by a 200-megapixel sensor with OIS, three colour options, and slim display bezels. The handset will run OriginOS 6 and pack a 7,000mAh battery with 90W FlashCharge support, along with IP68 and IP69 dust and water resistance ratings. Expected specifications include a 6.83-inch 120Hz AMOLED display, MediaTek Dimensity 7360-Turbo chipset, up to 12GB RAM, and a 32-megapixel front camera.
title: Vivo V70 FE Colour Options, Key Specifications Revealed Ahead of March 9 Launch

description: Apple’s iPhone 17e is a more affordable option in the iPhone 17 lineup, positioned below the standard iPhone 17. Both phones run on the A19 chip and support Apple Intelligence, but the iPhone 17 adds upgrades such as a larger 120Hz ProMotion display, a dual rear camera system, and longer battery life. The iPhone 17e starts at Rs. 64,900 in India, while the iPhone 17 starts at Rs. 82,900. Both run iOS 26 and share similar design elements, but differ in display, camera setup, and charging speeds.
title: iPhone 17e vs iPhone 17: Price in India, Features and Specifications Compared

description: Apple may have inadvertently disclosed the name of its rumoured budget laptop ahead of its expected launch this week. A report by MacRumors says a regulatory listing referencing a device called the MacBook Neo briefly appeared on Apple’s European compliance website before being removed. The laptop is expected to sit below the MacBook Air in Apple’s lineup and may use an A-series chip designed for iPhones. Reports also suggest it could feature a 12.9-inch display and drop features such as True Tone and fast charging to lower costs.
title: Apple MacBook Neo Reportedly Listed on Regulatory Site Hours Before Anticipated Launch

description: Tecno Pop X was launched in India on Wednesday as a budget smartphone. It will go on sale later this week and features an LCD display with a 120Hz refresh rate. It allows users to make calls to nearby devices even without a cellular network connection, offering added convenience in low‑coverage areas.
title: Tecno Pop X Launched in India With 5,000mAh Battery, IP64 Rating: Price, Specifications

description: Tecno unveiled the Megapad 2 tablet, Watch GT 1S smartwatch, and FreeHear 2 earbuds at MWC 2026. The Megapad 2 features an 11-inch 2.5K display with a 90Hz refresh rate and AI tools for translation and study. The Watch GT 1S offers dual-band GPS, health monitoring, AI watch faces, and up to 15 days of battery life. The FreeHear 2 earbuds adopt an open-ear design with a 10.8mm driver, Bluetooth 5.4, and up to 46 hours of claimed battery life. Pricing has not yet been announced.
title: Tecno Megapad 2, Tecno Watch GT 1S and Tecno FreeHear 2 Unveiled at MWC 2026: Availability, Features

description: Mike & Nick & Nick & Alice is an upcoming Sci-Fi Action-comedy film that is set to land on March 27th, 2026, only on Hulu.
title: Mike & Nick & Nick & Alice OTT Release Date: Know When and Where to Watch it Online

description: MediaTek demonstrated support for wireless emergency alerts sent through satellite links, working together with Starlink. The chipmaker is partnering with Starlink to add satellite communication features. MediaTek says more than 4.4 million people have used Starlink Mobile during emergencies, and the Wireless Emergency Alerts system is already available in Canada, Japan, and the US. The firm also showed AI privacy glasses and long‑range zoom technology at MWC 2026 in Barcelona.
title: MediaTek Showcases AI Glasses at MWC 2026; Demonstrates Emergency Satellite Alerts With Starlink

description: Devagudi, released on January 30, 2026, is a Rayalaseema-based drama now streaming on SunNXT. Directed by Bellam Ramakrishna Reddy, it follows friends whose lives fall apart due to caste tensions and a pivotal conflict. Despite low box office performance, the film has gained renewed online interest.
title: Devagudi Now Streaming Online: Where to Watch Intense Drama Online?

description: Apple launched the Studio Display and Studio Display XDR on Tuesday. The monitors feature 27-inch 5K Retina panels, while the XDR model adds mini-LED backlighting, up to 2,000 nits peak HDR brightness, and a 120Hz refresh rate with Adaptive Sync. Both displays also offer Thunderbolt 5 connectivity, a 12-megapixel Centre Stage camera with Desk View support, and a six-speaker audio system. In India, prices start at Rs. 1,89,900 and Rs. 3,99,900, respectively.
title: Apple Studio Display, Studio Display XDR With 27-Inch 5K Displays Launched in India: Price, Features

description: Directed by Saurabh Shukla, Jab Khuli Kitaab stars Pankaj Kapur and Dimple Kapadia in a mature romantic comedy about love, secrets, and rediscovery. Premiering March 6, 2026, exclusively on ZEE5, the film explores how relationships evolve over time. IMDb rating will be available after release.
title: Jab Khuli Kitaab OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Pankaj Kapur and Dimple Kapadia Starrer Romantic Drama Online?

description: Apple has updated its MacBook Pro lineup with new M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, its latest Apple Silicon processors. Built on Apple’s Fusion Architecture, the chipsets include six new high‑performance cores and 12 performance cores, claimed to deliver up to 30 percent faster CPU output. The GPU can be configured with up to 40 cores, each featuring a neural accelerator. The new MacBook Pro models with these chips will be available in the coming days, and are already available to preorder in India.
title: Apple Introduces M5 Pro, M5 Max Chips With New Fusion Architecture on 2026 MacBook Pro Models

description: Jockey explores the emotional and competitive world of Madurai’s goat-fighting sport. Directed by Pragabhal and starring Yuvan Krishna, Ridhaan Krishnas, and Ammu Abhirami, the film blends rural action with cultural depth. Now streaming on Amazon Prime Video, it holds a solid IMDb rating of 8.0/10 and continues to attract audiences who appreciate authentic Tamil storytelling.
title: Jockey Now Available for Streaming Online: Where to Watch This Tamil Action Movie Online?
